import ast,inspect,json,sys,threading,unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

case=UpdateM7PostgresqlTests('runTest');case.setUp()
instances=[]
threads_before=set(threading.enumerate())
real_init=proof.ConcurrentUpdates.__init__
def capture(self,*args,**kwargs):
    real_init(self,*args,**kwargs);instances.append(self)
try:
    with patch.object(proof.ConcurrentUpdates,'__init__',capture):
        if sys.argv[1]=='convergence':
            # Remove only reconcile's final action UPDATE in memory. Real
            # claim.read/_expire, SQL locking/observations and Flask GET remain.
            tree=ast.parse(inspect.getsource(execution.reconcile));removed=0
            for node in ast.walk(tree):
                if isinstance(node,ast.Expr) and isinstance(node.value,ast.Call):
                    args=node.value.args
                    if args and isinstance(args[0],ast.Constant) and isinstance(args[0].value,str) and args[0].value.startswith('UPDATE document_actions SET state=%s,phase=%s,reason_code=%s,updated_at='):
                        node.value=ast.Constant(None);removed+=1
            assert removed==1
            namespace={};exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(tree),'<negative-m7-convergence>','exec'),execution.__dict__,namespace)
            try:
                with patch.object(execution,'reconcile',namespace['reconcile']):
                    proof.exercise_two_updates(case,overlap=True)
            except AssertionError as error:
                print(json.dumps({'expected_failure':str(error),'trace':instances[0].trace}),flush=True)
                assert "('executing', 'confirmed') != ('remote_uncertain', 'interrupted')" in str(error)
                assert case.env.rows("SELECT state FROM conversation_turn_claims WHERE kind='confirmation' ORDER BY state")==[('failed',),('lost',)]
            else:raise AssertionError('negative convergence survived')
        elif sys.argv[1] in ('cleanup','cleanup-supervisor'):
            real=case.env.assert_no_transaction
            def injected_failure():
                real()
                raise AssertionError('injected_harness_failure_after_two_puts')
            try:
                with patch.object(case.env,'assert_no_transaction',injected_failure):
                    if sys.argv[1]=='cleanup-supervisor':
                        real_join=proof.ConcurrentUpdates.join_supervisors
                        def disagree(harness):
                            with patch.object(harness.reservations[0]._stop,'is_set',return_value=False):
                                real_join(harness)
                        with patch.object(proof.ConcurrentUpdates,'join_supervisors',disagree):
                            proof.exercise_two_updates(case,overlap=True)
                    else:
                        proof.exercise_two_updates(case,overlap=True)
            except AssertionError as error:
                assert str(error)=='injected_harness_failure_after_two_puts'
                print(json.dumps({'expected_failure':str(error),'trace':instances[0].trace}),flush=True)
            else:raise AssertionError('injected harness failure not propagated')
            harness=instances[0]
            if sys.argv[1]=='cleanup-supervisor':
                joined=next(e for e in harness.trace if e['event']=='supervisors_joined')
                assert joined['observed']==[dict(stop=False,alive=False),dict(stop=True,alive=False)]
                cleanup=harness.trace[-1]
                assert cleanup['errors']==['AssertionError'] and cleanup['connections_closed']
            assert len(harness.futures)==2 and all(f.done() for f in harness.futures)
            assert len(harness.reservations)==2
            assert all(r._stop.is_set() and not r._thread.is_alive() for r in harness.reservations)
            assert all(c.closed for c in harness.connections)
            assert not any(t.name.startswith('m7-confirm-proof') for t in threading.enumerate())
            assert set(threading.enumerate()) <= threads_before, 'proof-created thread survives'
            with case.conn() as conn:
                conn.execute('SELECT id FROM workspace_folders FOR UPDATE NOWAIT').fetchall()
                conn.execute('SELECT id FROM conversations FOR UPDATE NOWAIT').fetchall()
                assert conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND state='idle in transaction'").fetchone()==(0,)
            print(json.dumps({'cleanup_verified':True,'futures':2,'supervisors':2,'connections_closed':len(harness.connections)}))
        else:raise AssertionError('unknown negative')
finally:case.doCleanups()
